title: Escape from Atari
intro: A group in atari has one liberty left. You may be able to save it by extending into more space.

steps.instruction: Black has one liberty. Extend there to save the stone.
steps.hint: There is exactly one empty point touching it. Go there.
steps.explanation: The new stone joins the group and gives it more liberties.

steps.instruction: Save these two black stones by extending.
steps.hint: Look at where the wall stops.
steps.explanation: The group can now reach more empty crossings. Check those crossings before choosing an escape.

steps.instruction: Save the group of four black stones.
steps.hint: The end of the wall, same as before.
steps.explanation: The same kind of extension saves this larger group.

outro: When a group is in atari, check whether it can extend, connect or capture its way out.
